title: The case for and against the Ravens drafting CB in Round 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The case for and against the Ravens drafting CB in Round 1
sources.description: In the 2026 NFL draft, the Baltimore Ravens will enter the weekend equipped with 11 total picks at their disposal. That includes the No. 14 overall selection in the first round on Thursday night. The Ravens traditionally stick to their “best player available” drafting strategy but also have a few prominent roster needs to address. […]
